kind: Actual Expo UI, synthetic microphones, real WebRTC peers, isolated PostgreSQL and Redis
browser: Chromium, separate rider and driver sessions

checks.name: both assigned participants load the real chat UI
rider sends and driver receives one persisted message
driver replies and rider receives it
read receipts appear in both sessions
offline send stays pending then reconnects without duplicates
sent history and unsent draft survive leaving the interface
offline conversation reload restores both history and unsent draft
sending clears the draft across a fresh page load
browser microphone denial never rings the peer or creates a call
direct-only local calling is advertised without any TURN credentials
browser caller rings the recipient and both exchange real encrypted WebRTC audio packets
browser mute and in-app navigation preserve the same active call
authorized reconnect replaces both browser peers and resumes encrypted audio
hanging up closes browser peers, releases microphone tracks, and ends the server call
read-only history is enforced after trip completion
completed-trip call page gives the correct reason and cannot start a call
unassigned account cannot read chat history

dataIsolation: Disposable database and Redis; external browser requests blocked; no real users, SMS or push delivery.
